title: 高级替换词表
desc: 把作文里的初级词升级为中高级表达，覆盖四十组高频替换对，直接提升语言得分档次。

entries.example: It is crucial that college students strike a proper balance between study and social practice.
entries.exampleZh: 大学生在学业与社会实践之间取得恰当平衡至关重要。
entries.note: 常用于 It is crucial that… 结构，从句谓语用(should) do。

entries.example: The Internet has become an indispensable part of our daily life and work.
entries.exampleZh: 互联网已成为我们日常生活和工作中不可或缺的一部分。
entries.note: 多修饰事物，搭配 be indispensable to/for sth。

entries.example: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping their children's character and values.
entries.exampleZh: 父母在塑造孩子的性格与价值观方面起着关键作用。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词，主语多为事物或群体。

entries.example: Reading classic literature is beneficial to the development of independent thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读经典文学有助于培养独立思考能力。
entries.note: 固定搭配 be beneficial to sb/sth，介词只用 to。

entries.example: Volunteering in rural schools proved to be a rewarding experience for college students.
entries.exampleZh: 到乡村学校支教对大学生来说是一段有收获的经历。
entries.note: 多修饰 experience、job 等，强调付出后有回报。

entries.example: Their efforts to help the elderly in the community are highly commendable.
entries.exampleZh: 他们帮助社区老人的努力非常值得称赞。
entries.note: 修饰行为、举措，常与 highly 连用。

entries.example: Excessive reliance on smartphones is detrimental to students' eyesight and concentration.
entries.exampleZh: 过度依赖智能手机有害于学生的视力和注意力。
entries.note: 固定搭配 be detrimental to sth，比 harmful 更正式。

entries.example: Staying up late has an adverse effect on both health and academic performance.
entries.exampleZh: 熬夜对健康和学业表现都有不利影响。
entries.note: 高频搭配 adverse effect/impact on sth。

entries.example: Pressing children too hard to excel may prove counterproductive in the long run.
entries.exampleZh: 过度施压让孩子出类拔萃，从长远看可能适得其反。
entries.note: 多作表语，指手段与目的相违背。

entries.example: A multitude of graduates are competing for a limited number of well-paid positions.
entries.exampleZh: 众多毕业生正在竞争数量有限的高薪岗位。
entries.note: 后接可数名词复数，谓语动词用复数。

entries.example: Global warming has brought a host of challenges to coastal cities.
entries.exampleZh: 全球变暖给沿海城市带来了诸多挑战。
entries.note: a host of problems/challenges 为高频搭配。

entries.example: An increasing number of young people choose to work in big cities after graduation.
entries.exampleZh: 越来越多的年轻人毕业后选择在大城市工作。
entries.note: 只接可数名词复数，谓语动词用复数。

entries.example: Online education is increasingly popular among working adults.
entries.exampleZh: 在线教育在在职成年人中越来越受欢迎。
entries.note: 修饰形容词或副词，不能直接修饰名词。

entries.example: Many educators hold the view that creativity matters more than mere memorization.
entries.exampleZh: 许多教育工作者认为创造力比单纯记忆更重要。
entries.note: 后接完整句子，适合引出他人观点。

entries.example: Some critics contend that standardized tests fail to measure real ability.
entries.exampleZh: 一些批评者认为标准化考试无法衡量真正的能力。
entries.note: 及物动词，后接 that 从句，语气较强。

entries.example: From my perspective, the advantages of online learning far outweigh its drawbacks.
entries.exampleZh: 在我看来，在线学习的优点远大于缺点。
entries.note: 逗号后接完整句子，适合段首引出观点。

entries.example: I am firmly convinced that diligence is the key to academic success.
entries.exampleZh: 我坚信勤奋是学业成功的关键。
entries.note: 语气坚定，适合结尾段表明立场。

entries.example: Competition for jobs has become exceedingly fierce in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来求职竞争变得极其激烈。
entries.note: 修饰形容词或副词，属正式书面语。

entries.example: The city has changed remarkably over the past two decades.
entries.exampleZh: 过去二十年里，这座城市发生了显著变化。
entries.note: 可修饰动词与形容词，强调程度引人注目。

entries.example: The project requires an enormous amount of time and money.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目需要投入大量的时间和金钱。
entries.note: 常搭 an enormous amount of + 不可数名词。

entries.example: A considerable number of parents are worried about their children's screen time.
entries.exampleZh: 相当多的家长担心孩子的屏幕使用时间。
entries.note: 高频搭配 a considerable number/amount of。

entries.example: There has been a slight decline in the number of traffic accidents this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年交通事故的数量略有下降。
entries.note: 常修饰 decline、increase、difference 等。

entries.example: The new policy had only a marginal effect on housing prices.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策对房价只有微小的影响。
entries.note: 修饰 effect/change，指几乎可忽略不计。

entries.example: Students can obtain valuable experience through part-time jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 学生可以通过兼职获得宝贵的经验。
entries.note: 及物动词，后直接接具体事物，不接双宾语。

entries.example: Children acquire language skills most effectively through daily communication.
entries.exampleZh: 儿童通过日常交流最有效地习得语言技能。
entries.note: 多指经努力获得知识、技能或习惯。

entries.example: Renewable energy can generate huge economic benefits for the whole society.
entries.exampleZh: 可再生能源能为全社会创造巨大的经济效益。
entries.note: 及物动词，常接 benefits、income、interest。

entries.example: The excessive use of disposable products has produced undesirable consequences.
entries.exampleZh: 一次性产品的过度使用已造成不良后果。
entries.note: 及物动词，多接结果、影响类名词。

entries.example: The new subway line will facilitate communication between the two districts.
entries.exampleZh: 新地铁线路将便利两个城区之间的往来。
entries.note: 及物动词，后接名词或动名词，不接 to do。

entries.example: Regular exercise contributes to both physical health and mental well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 规律锻炼有助于身体健康和心理健康。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词；也可表导致某种结果。

entries.example: We should fully utilize digital resources to improve our learning efficiency.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应充分利用数字资源来提高学习效率。
entries.note: 及物动词，比 use 正式，多接资源、时间。

entries.example: Graduates should capitalize on every opportunity to gain practical experience.
entries.exampleZh: 毕业生应利用每一个机会获取实践经验。
entries.note: 后接机会、优势类名词，介词只能用 on。

entries.example: The chart demonstrates a steady rise in the number of online shoppers.
entries.exampleZh: 该图表表明网购人数持续上升。
entries.note: 及物动词，接名词或 that 从句，图表作文常用。

entries.example: This case clearly illustrates the importance of teamwork in modern society.
entries.exampleZh: 这一案例清楚说明了团队合作在现代社会的重要性。
entries.note: 及物动词，常接观点、道理，也可指配图。

entries.example: The overuse of chemical fertilizers has given rise to serious soil pollution.
entries.exampleZh: 化肥的过度使用已导致严重的土壤污染。
entries.note: 后接名词，多指不良后果。

entries.example: Careless driving often results in serious traffic accidents.
entries.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶常常导致严重的交通事故。
entries.note: 主语是原因，宾语是结果；勿与 result from 混淆。

entries.example: The government should take effective measures to tackle urban traffic congestion.
entries.exampleZh: 政府应采取有效措施解决城市交通拥堵问题。
entries.note: 及物动词，直接接 problem、issue 等名词。

entries.example: Universities must address the growing mental health needs of students.
entries.exampleZh: 高校必须应对学生日益增长的心理健康需求。
entries.note: 及物动词，此处意为着手处理，非致辞。

entries.example: Reading widely can enhance our ability to think critically.
entries.exampleZh: 广泛阅读能增强我们的批判性思维能力。
entries.note: 及物动词，多接 ability、quality、efficiency。

entries.example: The company optimized its management system to raise working efficiency.
entries.exampleZh: 该公司优化了管理体系以提高工作效率。
entries.note: 及物动词，多接结构、流程、配置类名词。

entries.example: The rapid growth of cities necessitates large investment in public transport.
entries.exampleZh: 城市的快速扩张使公共交通的大量投入成为必要。
entries.note: 及物动词，主语多为客观情况，不用于人。

entries.example: The serious situation calls for immediate action from all sides.
entries.exampleZh: 严峻的形势需要各方立即采取行动。
entries.note: 主语为事物时表示需要，后接名词或动名词。

entries.example: Individuals should take responsibility for reducing plastic waste in daily life.
entries.exampleZh: 个人应为减少日常生活中的塑料垃圾承担责任。
entries.note: 可数名词，泛指人们时须用复数形式。

entries.example: The general public should be encouraged to adopt a low-carbon lifestyle.
entries.exampleZh: 应鼓励公众采取低碳的生活方式。
entries.note: 固定搭配须加定冠词 the，作主语时谓语用单数。

entries.example: Whether to work or study abroad is a matter of personal choice.
entries.exampleZh: 工作还是出国深造是个人选择的问题。
entries.note: a matter of… 为高频结构，后接抽象名词。

entries.example: We should consider the issue from every aspect before making a decision.
entries.exampleZh: 做决定之前，我们应从各个方面考虑这一问题。
entries.note: 常搭配 from the… aspect、in this aspect。

entries.example: A flexible approach to learning is more effective than rigid memorization.
entries.exampleZh: 灵活的学习方法比死记硬背更有效。
entries.note: 搭配 an approach to doing sth，to 后接动名词。

entries.example: Public transport is an effective means of easing traffic pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 公共交通是缓解交通压力的有效手段。
entries.note: 单复数同形，常搭 a means of doing sth。

entries.example: Many graduates face the dilemma of choosing between stability and opportunity.
entries.exampleZh: 许多毕业生面临在稳定与机遇之间选择的两难困境。
entries.note: 指难以取舍的处境，常搭 face the dilemma of。

entries.example: Lack of confidence is the biggest obstacle to personal growth.
entries.exampleZh: 缺乏自信是个人成长最大的障碍。
entries.note: 固定搭配 an obstacle to sth，介词用 to。

entries.example: Adapting to a new working environment can be challenging for fresh graduates.
entries.exampleZh: 适应新的工作环境对刚毕业的学生来说颇具挑战。
entries.note: 含积极意味，比 difficult 更委婉得体。

entries.example: Reducing carbon emissions is a formidable task for developing countries.
entries.exampleZh: 减少碳排放对发展中国家来说是一项艰巨的任务。
entries.note: 多修饰 task、challenge、obstacle 等名词。

entries.example: The solution to this problem is actually quite straightforward.
entries.exampleZh: 这个问题的解决办法其实相当简单明了。
entries.note: 指步骤清楚、不复杂，可作表语或定语。

entries.example: Online courses have made higher education accessible to more learners.
entries.exampleZh: 在线课程使更多学习者能够接受高等教育。
entries.note: 搭配 be accessible to sb，介词固定为 to。

entries.example: I would be delighted to share my experience with the new members.
entries.exampleZh: 我很乐意与新成员分享我的经验。
entries.note: 常用 be delighted to do sth，语气礼貌得体。

entries.example: Many young people feel frustrated when their efforts bring no immediate results.
entries.exampleZh: 当努力没有立即带来结果时，许多年轻人会感到沮丧。
entries.note: 侧重因受挫而灰心，可作表语或定语。

entries.example: The small village is surrounded by picturesque mountains and clear streams.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小村庄被风景如画的群山和清澈的溪流环绕。
entries.note: 专用于描写景色，不用于形容人物外貌。

entries.example: Solving the housing problem requires a considerable amount of public investment.
entries.exampleZh: 解决住房问题需要大量的公共投资。
entries.note: 只接不可数名词，谓语动词用单数。

entries.example: Owing to the rapid development of technology, our lifestyle has changed greatly.
entries.exampleZh: 由于科技的快速发展，我们的生活方式发生了巨大变化。
entries.note: 介词短语，后接名词或动名词，不接句子。

entries.example: He succeeded by virtue of his perseverance and hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 他凭借坚持和努力取得了成功。
entries.note: 后接名词或动名词，含借助某种优势之意。

entries.example: The task is difficult; nevertheless, we must spare no effort to accomplish it.
entries.exampleZh: 这项任务很艰巨，然而我们必须不遗余力地完成它。
entries.note: 连接副词，前用分号或句号，不能直接连接两句。

entries.example: Some people prefer city life, whereas others enjoy the peace of the countryside.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人偏爱城市生活，而另一些人则喜欢乡村的宁静。
entries.note: 从属连词，引导对比从句，须连接两个分句。

entries.example: Many students lack sleep; consequently, their efficiency in class declines.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生睡眠不足，因此课堂效率下降。
entries.note: 连接副词，可置于句首，后面加逗号。

entries.example: Reading as well as traveling broadens our horizons.
entries.exampleZh: 阅读和旅行都能开阔我们的视野。
entries.note: 连接并列成分；作主语时谓语与前面的成分一致。

entries.example: Moreover, a healthy diet can improve our ability to concentrate.
entries.exampleZh: 此外，健康的饮食能提高我们的注意力。
entries.note: 句首连接副词，后接逗号，用于递进。

entries.example: Ultimately, success depends on persistent effort rather than good luck.
entries.exampleZh: 归根结底，成功取决于持续的努力而非好运。
entries.note: 可置于句首或句中，含最终结论的意味。

entries.example: In contemporary society, lifelong learning has become a necessity rather than a choice.
entries.exampleZh: 在当代社会，终身学习已成为必需而非选择。
entries.note: 作时间状语置于句首，后面加逗号。

entries.example: We ought to take concrete actions to protect the environment.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应当采取具体行动保护环境。
entries.note: 情态动词，后接动词原形，否定式为 ought not to。

entries.example: Hard work invariably brings progress, though it may take time.
entries.exampleZh: 努力总会带来进步，尽管可能需要时间。
entries.note: 修饰动词或形容词，书面语，比 always 更正式。

entries.example: More often than not, success comes to those who persist to the end.
entries.exampleZh: 成功往往属于那些坚持到底的人。
entries.note: 固定短语作状语，常置于句首，后接逗号。

entries.example: Occasionally, taking a break can help us work more efficiently.
entries.exampleZh: 偶尔休息一下能帮助我们更高效地工作。
entries.note: 频率低于 sometimes，位置灵活，可置于句首。
